source_title: 길드 가입 2일차에 인사안했다고 뭐라하길래 귀찮아서 나왔는데 이렇게 귓왔다 내가 이상한거냐
subtitle: 아무도 인사 안 하는 길드에서 나가라길래 나갔더니 날아온 귓말

cuts.speaker: 언데드 성기사
cuts.dialogue:
길드 2일차, 5명 접속.
아무도 인사 없으니 편하네~
cuts.visual_prompt: High-angle quiet tavern corner shot in cute 2.5-head chibi SD style on a pure #FFFFFF background with minimal wooden floor plank touch and zero panel borders, text, or speech bubbles. On the left, relaxed Undead Paladin (gold warhammer stowed on back) sits comfortably sipping from an uncorked open-necked warm glass tea flask with the wooden cork visibly removed on the floor beside her, heavy-lidded golden eyes calm and sleepy. On the right, silent Troll Shaman (wooden totem staff stowed on back) sits peacefully dozing with closed eyes and quiet stillness.

cuts.speaker: 오크 전사
cuts.dialogue:
접속했는데 왜 인사 안 함?
룰 맘에 안 들면 나가던가!
cuts.visual_prompt: Low-angle sudden scolding whisper shot in cute 2.5-head chibi SD style on a pure #FFFFFF background with minimal stone floor touch and zero panel borders, text, or speech bubbles. On the left, bossy fuming Orc Warrior guild master (fair peach skin (never green skin), green plush orc hood with TWO curved ivory horns, jet-black ponytail, battle axe stowed on back) looms forward pointing a lecturing empty finger with blazing crimson eyes and pink whisper sparkles swirling near her hand. On the right, unbothered Undead Paladin (gold warhammer stowed on back) blinks lazily holding her uncorked open-necked glass tea flask with the wooden cork visibly removed on the floor beside her.

cuts.speaker: 언데드 성기사
cuts.dialogue:
면담 땐 그런 룰 없었는데…
귀찮네, 그냥 조용히 길탈.
cuts.visual_prompt: Side-profile deadpan exit shot in cute 2.5-head chibi SD style on a pure #FFFFFF background with minimal stone floor touch and zero panel borders, text, or speech bubbles. On the left, completely calm Undead Paladin (gold warhammer stowed on back) casually unpins a tiny purple guild crest ribbon from her white-gold cape with empty fingers and sets it neatly down, turning to leave with serene tired golden eyes. On the right, Orc Warrior guild master (fair peach skin (never green skin), green plush orc hood with TWO curved ivory horns, jet-black ponytail, battle axe stowed on back) freezes stiff with wide twitching eyes as her bluff gets called instantly.

Centered Dutch-tilt extreme big bust-up close-up filling 83 percent of frame height in cute 2.5-head chibi SD style on a pure #FFFFFF background with zero panel borders, text, or speech bubbles. Red-faced fuming Orc Warrior guild master (fair peach skin (never green skin), green plush orc hood with TWO curved ivory horns, jet-black ponytail, battle axe stowed away) trembles furiously with bulging crimson eyes, gritted teeth, puffing white steam clouds, and a throbbing comic anger vein on her forehead.

cuts.speaker: 오크 전사
cuts.dialogue:
진짜 말도 없이 나가냐?!
그렇게 살면 단체생활 망해!
cuts.visual_prompt: Over-the-shoulder shot from behind calm Undead Paladin (round white skull cap, gold warhammer stowed on back in lower-left foreground) looking at raging Orc Warrior guild master on the right, in cute 2.5-head chibi SD style on a pure #FFFFFF background with minimal stone floor touch and zero panel borders, text, or speech bubbles. On the right, furious Orc Warrior guild master (fair peach skin (never green skin), green plush orc hood with TWO curved ivory horns, jet-black ponytail, battle axe stowed on back) leans forward stomping and shaking both empty fists while angry glowing pink whisper wisps burst across the air.

cuts.speaker: 언데드 성기사
cuts.dialogue:
나가래서 나갔더니 훈수질?
응, 바로 차단 박고 솔플.
cuts.visual_prompt: Back-view deadpan victory finale in cute 2.5-head chibi SD style on a pure #FFFFFF background with minimal stone floor touch and zero panel borders, text, or speech bubbles. On the left, utterly serene Undead Paladin (gold warhammer stowed on back) strolls calmly away sipping from an uncorked open-necked warm glass tea flask with the wooden cork visibly removed beside her pouch while flicking a tiny glowing red silencing rune seal shut with her free hand. In the background on the right, shrunken fuming Orc Warrior guild master (fair peach skin (never green skin), green plush orc hood with TWO curved ivory horns, jet-black ponytail, battle axe stowed on back) hops angrily yelling into empty air behind a translucent silence barrier.
